title: Cauliflower, parsnip and bacon hash with eggs

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Bacon, vegetables, eggs, oil, herbs and smoked paprika are all ordinary home staples.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient is an everyday Tesco item at a normal price.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a large lidded frying pan and simple frying.

works.reason: Small florets and diced parsnip fried for 25 minutes will cook through and colour, and the eggs set under the lid, giving a sensible amount for four.

honest_times.reason: Twenty minutes is believable for peeling and dicing three parsnips, breaking up a cauliflower and slicing an onion, and the steps add up to 35 minutes of cooking.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning appears in the steps, the names match their ids and nothing unlisted is used.

seasonal_feel.reason: A warm cauliflower and parsnip hash suits early March, and the cauliflower is central to it.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are clear, plain British English a beginner could follow.

hearty_healthy.reason: Plenty of vegetables plus bacon and eggs make a satisfying family lunch.
